items.title: São Miguel do Anta (MG) Education procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #2
items.en_title: São Miguel do Anta (MG) Education procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #2
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in São Miguel do Anta (MG) is procuring education-related goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 55,200; proposals close Nov 26, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
